title: Refined power bound
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose $0<r<1$, $0<p\le p_a<1$, and the biased-minus probability polynomial of $f$ at $p_a$ is at most $r$. Then its value at $p$ is at most $r(p/p_a)^{1-r}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
